definitions.gloss: each company, every company, all the companies
definitions.explanation: Refers to each of the companies in a group or industry. Commonly used in news and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {各社|かくしゃ}の{代表|だいひょう}が{集|あつ}まった。
{各社|かくしゃ}が{新|あたら}しい{製品|せいひん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: Each company announced a new product.

examples.japanese: {携帯|けいたい}{電話|でんわ}の{料金|りょうきん}は{各社|かくしゃ}によって{違|ちが}うので、よく{比|くら}べてから{選|えら}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: Mobile phone rates differ by company, so it's better to compare carefully before choosing.

notes:
{各社|かくしゃ} means "each company" or "every company" in a group. Frequently used in news, business reports, and formal writing when discussing industry-wide trends or comparisons.

FORMS:
{各|かく} (each) + {社|しゃ} (company).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {各社|かくしゃ}が〜する: each company does ~
- {各社|かくしゃ}の{対応|たいおう}: each company's response
- {各社|かくしゃ}によって{異|こと}なる: differs by company

SIMILAR {各|かく} COMPOUNDS:
- {各国|かっこく}: each country
- {各地|かくち}: each region/area
- {各自|かくじ}: each person, individually
- {各種|かくしゅ}: each kind, various kinds

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news articles and business contexts. In casual speech, それぞれの{会社|かいしゃ} would be more natural.
